title.v: Đề nghị nghỉ phép/ chế độ

options.query: select ma_ttct, ten_ttct%l from dmttct where ma_ct = '@@voucherCode' and status = 1 order by stt

query.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000) set @strKey =' ma_ct = ''RB1''' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmloainghi c on a.ma_loainghi = c.ma_loainghi left join dmcalv d on a.ma_ca = d.ma_ca','b.ma_unit, c.ten_loainghi, d.ten_ca', '@@key', '', @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId drop table #unitright

finding.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(3000), @strDetailKey nvarchar(3000); set @strDetailKey = '' set @strKey = 'ngay_ct between ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct1, 112) + ''' and ''' + convert(char(8), @ngay_ct2, 112) + ''' and ' + @strFinding + ' and ' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionGetUnitIDRightKeys(@@admin, @@userId, @ma_unit, 'a.unit_id') + @strDetailKey set @strKey = @strKey +' and ma_ct = ''RB1''' exec ISWIFTStoreVoucherTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', 'left join sysunit b on a.unit_id = b.unit_id left join dmloainghi c on a.ma_loainghi = c.ma_loainghi left join dmcalv d on a.ma_ca = d.ma_ca','b.ma_unit, c.ten_loainghi, d.ten_ca', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 0, @@admin, @@userId drop table #unitright
